_comment: Configuration only. No detection logic lives here. Edit to customise actors, policies, and notification text. Detection logic is in actor_registry.py and agent_guard.py.
_description: CoworkGuard AI Actor Registry. Defines known AI actors on macOS. Edit to add custom actors.

accessibility_access.note: Detects AX notifications and permission grants. Does not intercept every kAXValueAttribute read.

network_access.note: Uses lsof polling. Not a true kernel-level monitor. Cannot intercept raw sockets or non-TCP traffic.

explanations.PROMPT_API_USED: A website started a local AI session inside your browser using Chrome's built-in Gemini Nano model. The AI runs on your device, not in the cloud.

explanations.LOCAL_MODEL_UPDATED: Chrome updated its local AI model file.
explanations.EXTENSION_HOOK_DETECTED: A browser extension has modified how Chrome handles network requests on AI pages. This could allow it to read your AI conversations.

visibility.description: Monitor and log all AI actor activity. Notify on significant events. No blocking. Recommended for most users.

enforcement.description: Actively block or require approval for risky actions. For power users and security teams.
